projectIdSource: apps/web/.env.local (NEXT_PUBLIC_*, ignored by git; public by design, cannot sign or move funds)
whatThisProves: The dapp reached the WalletConnect relay, got an attestation scoped to this project id, and rendered a scannable pairing QR. Without the project id the connector is never registered and the relay handshake cannot start.
notProven: No phone wallet scanned the QR, so no session was established and no signature was produced over WalletConnect.
blocker: HUMAN_REQUIRED: scan the QR with a mobile wallet on X Layer 196, sign, and record the phone wallet name/version.
howToComplete: Open /wallet-check, click WalletConnect, scan with a phone wallet, sign the test approval, then run: tsx scripts/real-integrations/wallet/verify-acceptance.ts <record.json>
